stages.report:
FALSIFIED
The belief that buying BTC/USDT after a close above its 200-day simple moving average and holding 30 trading days beats random entries is falsified on past data.

**What was tested**
Rule: When BTC/USDT closes above its 200-day simple moving average, buy at the next day's open and hold for 30 trading days. Criterion: mean net return per trade must beat random entries with the same holding period, alpha 0.05, min trades 20. Window 2017-08-17 to 2026-10-29. n_signals 1667, n_trades 63, avg_bars_held 30.0, mean_net_pct 5.21, median_net_pct 0.99, win_rate_pct 52.38, exposure_pct 56.23, total_net_pct 789.15, max_drawdown_pct -61.66, buy_and_hold_total_pct 1720.08, t_stat 2.15.

**Strongest evidence against**
Random-entry baseline failed. Rule mean 5.21% vs random-entry mean 4.73%; the rule beat 59% of 2000 random sets, one-sided p = 0.414. The pre-registered benchmark was not met and p = 0.414 is not significant even before correction for 3 sealed beliefs about BTC/USDT. Required p < 0.017 after correction.

**What held up**
Sample size passed: 63 completed trades from 1667 signals. Look-ahead guard passed: conditions use only past and current bars; every trade opens at next bar's open; indicators used: sma(200). Fee and slippage sensitivity passed: at 0.25% per side mean trade is 4.89%; edge disappears at about 271 bps per side. Time split passed: positive in both halves 5.27% (n=28) then 5.16% (n=35). Nearby parameters passed: 4 of 4 nearby variants point same way (median 4.77%). Cross asset passed: beats random entries on 7 of 9 other assets (0 significant at 5%).

**What would change the verdict**
A one-sided p < 0.017 for beating random entries on this sealed test, with at least 20 trades, would be required under the pre-registered alpha after correction for multiple sealed claims.

**Caveats**
Falsify tests beliefs about the past. It is not investment advice and makes no prediction. Rule compounded 789.1% while holding the asset over the same window returned 1720.1% with exposure 56% of the time.
